serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: We haven't gone bowling in a while. I wonder if you and Annalie got any better in the meantime.
You: As far as I’m concerned, I wasn’t really training in my free time.
Besides, if I went bowling alone, {f_botName} would probably get mad at me anyway…
Bot: And what about Annalie?
You: She really wanted to come, but I don’t think it’s a good idea if she’s still recovering from her injury.
#bot.Expression.Shock
You: I left the decision to Melissa, so I don’t know if she will be there with us.
Bot: What? Really? I didn’t know it was that bad.
You: It wasn’t. {{wi}}I think. I’m no doctor…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: It’s Annalie we are talking about, it’s hard to get anything out of her that isn’t a perverted joke, so it’s hard to assess how much it affected her. 
Bot: There’s some truth to this. 
You: Let’s get going then.
